info.name: Avoca Enterprise Analytics (v1) Analytics (v1) Teams API

items.docs: List the teams the API key can access. For multi-team keys, all accessible teams; for single-team keys, the one team. Requires the `read:teams` permission.

params.name: include_test_teams
params.description: Include designated internal QA/test teams in multi-team aggregations (default false)

items.docs: List all teams accessible with this API key. Requires the `read:teams` permission. Internal QA/test teams are excluded by default; pass `include_test_teams=true` to include them.
